variants.name: kill-then-commit
variants.note: The observer issues KILL, waits up to 2s for the server thread to disappear, then the subject sends COMMIT. This is a connection failure. It is not a discarded COMMIT reply.

connection_errors.name: Error
connection_errors.message: Connection lost: The server closed the connection.

variants.name: client-destroy-then-commit
variants.note: PromiseConnection.destroy() delegates to Connection.close(), which ends the socket and rejects later commands. COMMIT is attempted after that call. This is a client-side connection failure, not a lost response.

error.message: Can't add new command when connection is in closed state

variants.name: history-after-disconnect
variants.note: The history read happens after the subject connection has closed. A visible marker in fresh_reader is a later observation, not the COMMIT packet.
